cover_letter.greeting: Dear Capital One Financial Health and Inclusion Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Business Analyst role on the Financial Health Strategy team in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. The role caught my attention because it ties product and pricing analysis to whether customers actually end up better off, and that's the kind of question I like working on.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst, building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15% and running variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation options. At JPMorgan I analyzed marketing-channel budget allocation and found 30% efficiency gains by benchmarking past spend, and I built AI powered dashboards at Lenovo to bring predictive metrics into planning.
That maps to building business cases, testing hypotheses and tracking outcomes for your bank products. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the team's work.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli applying for the Senior Business Analyst, Financial Health Strategy role at Capital One. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and at JPMorgan I found 30% efficiency gains in marketing-channel budget allocation. I'd love to hear how your team measures financial health. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
